doc_master_id_migration.finding: The coordinated doc_master ID migration cannot be performed safely in this batch under the hard constraints 'Do not make UI changes' and 'preserve user-facing document meaning'. The frontend index.html resolves document tokens via its own DOC_DICT map (index.html:10104), NOT via doc_master.json. Resolution logic at index.html:11537 is: `DOC_DICT[key] || (key.startsWith('doc_') ? '문서요건(<id>)' : key)`. The 12 corrupted Korean-string IDs are NOT keys in DOC_DICT, so they currently render via the raw-string fallback as their own readable Korean document names. If they were renamed to machine IDs (doc_*) in visa_data.json without adding matching DOC_DICT entries in index.html, the renderer would display a generic placeholder '문서요건(...)' instead of the Korean document name, which DESTROYS user-facing document meaning. Adding DOC_DICT entries is a UI change, which is out of scope for this batch.
